cases.source:
with open('report.bin','w',encoding='utf-8',errors='strict',newline='\r\n') as target:
    print('initial',target.tell())
    for value in ['', 'A\né', '€😀', '\r\nZ']:
        before=target.tell()
        try:
            print('write',target.write(value),target.tell())
        except UnicodeEncodeError as error:
            print('error',error.start,error.end,error.object is value,target.tell()==before)
        target.flush()
        print('flushed',target.tell())
with open('report.bin','a',encoding='utf-8',errors='strict',newline='\r\n') as target:
    print('append',target.write('!'),target.tell())
with open('report.bin','rb') as result:
    print(result.read().hex())
cases.expected:
initial 0
write 0 0
flushed 0
write 3 5
flushed 5
write 2 12
flushed 12
write 3 16
flushed 16
append 1 17
